Source: Fayetteville State University 2026-2027 'Bachelor of Arts in Sociology Freshman Curriculum Planning Guide and Four-Year Plan' (official, Office of the Registrar; last update 4/16/2026).
Transcribed from the official Four-Year Plan tables (page 3). Course titles are the plan's own Requirement labels; 'See Guide'/'See Catalog'/blank-course slots are choice slots per the Curriculum Planning Guide. The plan notes some courses may be taken in an alternate order.
Prerequisite chain from the guide (reflected in the sequence order): MATH 123 or MATH 126 (or higher), then SOCI 331, then SOCI 335, then SOCI 480; SOCI 480 also requires graduating-senior standing and C or better in SOCI 210, 310, 335, 350.
